sources.title: tmux-ide v2.9.25 release
sources.finding: Assets: tmux-ide-tui for darwin-arm64, linux-arm64 and linux-x64 (gz with sha256); no Intel macOS or Windows build.

sources.title: Getting started
sources.finding: macOS 26+ on Apple Silicon or glibc Linux arm64/x64; Intel Macs not supported as of 2.9.6; Alpine and native Windows not supported (use WSL); bundles tmux 3.7c and Node; existing tmux servers must be 3.7+.

sources.title: Agent detection
sources.locator: How detection works; Claude Code integration
sources.finding: Four states blocked, working, done, idle from agent self-report (Claude Code hooks, @agent_state pane option) or process and screen manifests; agent explain shows the reason.

sources.title: Multi-agent teams
sources.finding: Shared status bus via team --json and events; send types into another agent's prompt; wait blocks on status or output; long messages go to .tasks/dispatch files.

sources.title: Agent automation
sources.locator: Read and send; Reserve, execute and recover
sources.finding: Scoped, auditable read and send of tmux panes through CLI, MCP or SDK with endpoints, reservations and retry-safe handles.

sources.title: Remote machines
sources.finding: Each remote machine runs its own daemon next to tmux; the app connects through an SSH tunnel with BatchMode; agents keep running when the app or connection closes.

sources.title: Restore and resume
sources.finding: tmux-ide restore rebuilds windows, layouts, cwd and titles from a 30 second snapshot; --resume-agents reopens Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and opencode conversations; commands are not replayed by default.

sources.title: Notifications and events
sources.finding: Toasts on every attached tmux client, macOS and terminal banners and sound when an agent goes blocked or done; events stream and wait commands.

sources.title: Worktrees
sources.finding: tmux-ide worktree create/open/list/remove makes a git worktree on a new branch with an adopted session.

sources.title: Plugins
sources.finding: Lua plugins add palette commands and tmux-ide action, with consent, time limits and memory caps; a worktree-tasks example.

sources.title: Native alpha
sources.finding: Public alpha native macOS app with Home, Terminals and Commands connecting to the same daemon; Developer ID signed and notarized; alpha bugs expected.

sources.title: CLI reference
sources.locator: Agent status and messaging; Saved SSH machines; Sessions and recovery
sources.finding: Command reference including integration, send, wait, events, team, automation, restore, machines, worktree, serve.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.finding: Optional .tmux-ide/workspace.yml layout and config.json settings.

sources.title: MCP server
sources.finding: Stdio MCP server tmux-ide-automation exposing scoped pane read and send operations.

sources.title: MCP manifest
sources.finding: Plugin manifest registering the stdio MCP server command tmux-ide mcp.

sources.title: SDK package
sources.finding: TypeScript SDK package sharing the automation operation API.

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: Update check asks the npm registry for the dist-tag; the only outbound request found besides installer downloads and SSH.

sources.title: Daemon terminal bridge
sources.finding: Daemon streams tmux panes to clients over local sockets with owner-only access.

sources.locator: grep -wi for posthog, sentry, plausible, mixpanel, amplitude over packages, src, native, apps, docs/content

sources.locator: grep -w for sso, saml, rbac, multi-user, invite, roles over packages
sources.finding: No accounts, roles or SSO; matches are visual tokens and test names.

sources.title: Bounded search: issue or task entity
sources.locator: grep for issue tracker, backlog, kanban, jira, linear, epic over packages and docs commands
sources.finding: No issue or task entity; .tasks/dispatch holds message files and the worktree-tasks plugin example treats worktrees as tasks.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.locator: grep -w for cron, schedule, webhook over packages
sources.finding: No scheduler or webhook trigger; the daemon only reacts to tmux events.

sources.title: Bounded search: container or VM isolation
sources.locator: grep -w for docker, podman, sandbox, bwrap over packages and docs commands
sources.finding: No container or sandbox feature for agents; docker mentions are the development environment.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost and usage
sources.locator: grep -w for cost, usd, spend, budget, token over packages
sources.finding: No cost, spend or budget tracking.

sources.title: Bounded search: diff or PR features
sources.locator: grep for pull request, gh pr, diff viewer over packages and commands
sources.finding: No diff viewer or PR feature; a Markdown reader and browser pane exist.

sources.title: tmux-ide Claude Code skill
sources.finding: The bundled skill (installed by tmux-ide integration install claude or skill-sync) tells an agent it can work as part of a team: read the fleet with team --json, task another pane with send, wait for output or status, and follow events, across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, aider or any CLI agent. It names no lead or orchestrator role.
